data.narrative:
Archetype AI is a Series A artificial intelligence and software company founded by Ivan Poupyrev, Brandon Barbello, Leonardo Giusti, Jaime Lien, and Nick Gillian. The company has raised $48M to date. Valuation analysis draws from a peer set of nine comparable companies—one public (Palantir, ticker PLTR) and eight private firms in the AI & Software sector at Series A or Series B stages, including Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total capital raised as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A-to-next-stage advancement, implies a valuation of $96M. Peer-median analysis across the five closest comparables yields a median valuation of $5.6B, with the peer sample ranging from $2.0B (Field AI) to $29.0B (Scale AI). The median reflects material diversity in stage and outcome within the AI cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $82M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median estimate of $2.8B. The wide dispersion reflects uncertainty inherent in early-stage AI company valuations, where peer outcomes at adjacent stages vary substantially. Resolution of key uncertainties—including revenue traction, product differentiation, and competitive position relative to both well-capitalized peers and emergent startups—will be critical to narrowing this range.
